summary.text: Jaxon Deur is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 101, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Christopher Crain (D) for a seat with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia describes him as a sales manager in the agricultural industry and the owner of Takeoff Marketing.

paragraphs.text: Deur graduated from Fremont High School and earned a bachelor's degree and a commercial pilot's license from Western Michigan University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career includes owning Takeoff Marketing and working as a sales manager for Modern Produce Equipment LLC, and he has served in an appointed position on the Newaygo County Tax Allocation Board.
Deur advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his priorities are local control, less regulation on small businesses and agriculture, transparency between government and constituents, economic opportunity for future generations and budget oversight to eliminate waste.
He described his campaign messages as future-focused leadership and local issues, local control and local solutions.
